title: Implement Ozi watch mode, FIFO dispatch, and lug start summaries
description: Add session-local Ozi watch support so builder sessions can poll for new ready work after idle periods, use FIFO claim ordering, and print a compact rich summary when a lug is claimed.
non_goals: Do not build a global daemon in this batch
Do not broaden beyond session-local builder polling
verification_requirements: Verify FIFO ordering is preserved when claiming ready lugs
Verify claimed lug output includes rich summary
Verify watch mode config is session-local and defaults to 5-minute idle polling

progress: ✅ Added --watch loop to wai_ozi.py for lightweight 5-minute polling
✅ Enforced FIFO dispatch ordering by created_at
✅ Added rich lug-start summary output with type/priority/tags/description
✅ Verified summaries print when lugs are claimed and builder-focused auto mode stays compact

commands: python3 wai_ozi.py after enabling auto mode
python3 wai_ozi.py after raising max_parallel to verify summary output

checks.requirement: Verify FIFO ordering is preserved when claiming ready lugs
checks.evidence: _fifo_ready_lugs() sorts by created_at ascending; auto_dispatch_work() iterates this sorted list; wai-auto-parallel.md docs confirm FIFO applies

checks.requirement: Verify claimed lug output includes rich summary
checks.evidence: render_start_summary() produces title, type, priority, tags, description; called by _dispatch_lug_to_subagent() before logging changelog entry

checks.requirement: Verify watch mode config is session-local and defaults to 5-minute idle polling
checks.evidence: load_runtime_config() defaults watch_mode=True, poll_interval_minutes=5; --watch arg reads interval from session config; main() loop uses sleep(interval_minutes * 60)

verification_record.notes: All three verification requirements pass. FIFO confirmed via sorted(created_at asc). Rich start summary confirmed in render_start_summary(). Watch mode is session-local with 5-min default confirmed in both code and runtime config.
